# Beyond Visibility

> Grades a live URL for how likely AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews) are to retrieve, trust, and cite it. The Technical Grader scores a Technical Score (crawler access, schema, metadata, freshness, extractability — 5 categories) and a Content Score for the page's own writing (AI Answerability, Structure & Chunking, Citations, and more — 7 categories), from one submission. A standalone paste/upload Content Grader for unpublished drafts is coming back soon.

## Pages

- [Home](https://beyondvisibility.live/): Product overview, the Technical Grader, and how each score is calculated.
- [About](https://beyondvisibility.live/about): What AEO and AISO mean, how they evolved from SEO, how an answer engine's retrieval pipeline actually works, and the exact rubric weights behind every score.
